sources.text:
Pico Nature Park is a Portuguese nature park located on the island of Pico, on the Azores. Created in 2008, it is the largest nature park of the archipelago, occupying 35% of the island (equivalent to 157.1 km2 (60.7 sq mi)) plus 74.38 km2 (28.72 sq mi) of marine domain.
